newsitem.title: USA: AT&T declines comment on BT-MCI merger talks.
newsitem.headline: AT&T declines comment on BT-MCI merger talks.

text.p: AT&T Corp declined to comment Friday on news that rival telecommunications giant MCI Communications and British Telecommunications Plc are in talks on a possible merger.

"We are not commenting," said an AT&T spokesman of the reports that BT and MCI were in advanced discussions on a deal in which BT would boost its stake in MCI to 100 percent from its current 20 percent.
"There is thing conclusive to comment on," the AT&T spokesman said, but added that: "We are watching with interest."

AT&T competes against the BT-MCI alliance known as Concert in Europe, where AT&T has formed a joint venture with the state telephone companies of the Netherlands, Switzerland, Spain and Sweden, and on a global scale through its World Partners alliance.
In 1995, AT&T began to compete directly in BT's home market when it received permission to begin offering local domestic and long distance resale services in Britain.
